title: Trigger
description: Listens and responds to trigger events.
content:
Trigger

Listens and responds to trigger events.

Component Common

Schema

JSON
{
  "trigger": {
    "events": {
      "eventName": ["command1", "command2"]
    }
  }
}

Description

The Trigger component listens for trigger events and responds by executing associated commands. It maps trigger event names to arrays of commands that are executed when the event fires.

Fields

FieldTypeDescription
eventsDictionary{string, string[]}Maps trigger event names to arrays of commands to execute when the event is fired.

Example

JSON
{
  "trigger": {
    "events": {
      "onPlayerEnter": ["entity.animate alert,once", "sound.play alarm"],
      "onPlayerExit": ["entity.animate idle,loop"]
    }
  }
}
